name: AI Drawer
description: Left-side sliding drawer panel implementing the LLMLOOP iterative code refinement strategy. Chat-style interface where users paste code and get refinement suggestions driven by five feedback loops: compilation fixes, test validation, static analysis, test generation, and mutation analysis. Connects to OpenAI-compatible LLM APIs. Settings stored in user preferences.

ipc.description: Load API key, model, endpoint from preferences

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the drawer with configured width
